Book correction: The book prints no condition on x, but the result is true only when \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{x}{2} lies in (0, \pi), the principal range of \cot^{-1}, i.e. for -\frac{3\pi}{2} < x < \frac{\pi}{2}. Example: at x = \pi the left side is \cot^{-1}(-1) = \frac{3\pi}{4} but the right side is \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{\pi}{2} = -\frac{\pi}{4}. Correct statement: \cot^{-1}\frac{\cos x}{1 - \sin x} = \frac{\pi}{4
